comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal from a connector; record extracts a fitted collar using a prepared screw puller and recovers both tool and collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade tab release and simultaneous tool-wire pulling versus stabilizing a puller, repeated screw turning with regrasping, lifting, jaw spreading, and unloading.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal exits without damage or unintended release versus collar clears after measured screw turns, lands in the tray, and intact puller is stably parked.
comparison.reason: The shared extraction objective is too generic; the force transmission, regrasping, recovery sequence, and retained mechanisms differ substantially.
